company.positioning_statement: AI Central is a media group and flagship publication focused on practical AI for senior professionals. We turn attention into pipeline for AI and SaaS brands by pairing premium placements with editorial-grade creative that speaks to senior operators
what_we_are_not: Not a marketing agency - we don't manage campaigns or run paid media for clients
Not a freelance writing service - placements are tied to our distribution
Not a tech blog - we curate for our specific senior audience
Not a B2B lead gen firm - we drive awareness/education/intent, direct response is a bonus
Not focused on beginners - our readers know what ChatGPT is

objections.reply: Totally fair - - want a quick 15 min to map your next product moment and I'll suggest 2 package options that fit the timeline?
objections.why_it_works: Doesn't push for a close now, reframes as free strategic value, offers optionality instead of one hard pitch

objections.reply: Yep - - quick context first: are you optimizing for signups, demos, or awareness? I'll send the right option so we don't spam you with irrelevant packages
objections.why_it_works: Qualifies the goal before quoting price so it feels tailored, signals competence

objections.reply: Got it - - if budget is tight, we can start with 1 placement, measure, then roll winners into a bundle - - what KPI matters most for you this month?
objections.why_it_works: De-risks by shrinking commitment, implies natural upsell path, redirects to KPI conversation

objections.reply: Love that - - we plug in where it's hardest: distribution to senior operators plus editorial creative that performs in feed - - we can also use your assets and just handle placement
objections.why_it_works: Validates their capability, isolates the real value-add, offers a lighter-touch option

objections.objection: Too expensive / poor CPC from a past placement (real example: Luis Girao, UX Pilot)
objections.reply: Reframed the package into 1 LinkedIn carousel + 1 CEO interview at the same price point, backed by explicit CPM/CPC math (~$16 CPM / ~$1.60 CPC) vs LinkedIn Ads benchmarks ($30-80+ CPM / $5-12+ CPC), plus a native content investment and brand-asset framing
objections.why_it_works: Reframes the format instead of arguing the number, then out-maths the objection with real benchmarks

hard_rules: Never use em dashes (—) - always use '- -' (two hyphens with a space)
Sign-off is always 'Cheers, A' or 'Cheers, Alex' - never Best/Regards/Thanks/Sincerely
Use P.S. sections for secondary asks or links
Short paragraphs - one to three sentences max
Lowercase greetings in casual/repeat contexts, capitalized for new/formal contacts
No bullet points in casual replies - reserved for proposals
tone_pillars: Warm opener, direct body, clear CTA
